mapper.sql: select tcheckresult.id, tcheckresult.task_detail_id, tcheckresult.status, tcheckresult.auditor, tcheckresult.check_difference_count, tcheckresult.remark, tcheckresult.create_by, tcheckresult.create_time, tcheckresult.update_by, tcheckresult.update_time, tcheckresult.dept_id, tcheckresult.dept_name, tcheckresult.del_flag from t_check_result tcheckresult
mapper.select:
select sum(check_difference_count) as check_difference_count, material_id, dept_id, dept_name from ( ( select sum(t5.actual_count - t5.rfid_head_count) as check_difference_count, t5.material_id, t2.dept_id, t2.dept_name from t_check_result t1 inner join t_task_detail t2 on t1.task_detail_id = t2.id inner join t_check_history t5 on t1.task_detail_id = t5.task_detail_id and t5.del_flag = '0'
inner join sys_user u on u.user_name = t1.create_by and u.status = '0' inner join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id and d.status = '0'
where t1.del_flag = '0' and t2.dept_id = #{deptId} and t5.material_id in
#{item}
and t5.material_code like concat('%',#{materialCode},'%')
${params.dataScope} group by t2.dept_id,t2.dept_name,t5.material_id ) union all ( select sum(t6.actual_count - t6.predict_count) as check_difference_count, t6.material_id, t2.dept_id, t2.dept_name from t_check_result t1 inner join t_task_detail t2 on t1.task_detail_id = t2.id inner join t_check_area_history t6 on t1.task_detail_id = t6.task_detail_id and t6.del_flag = '0' and t6.status = '4'
inner join sys_user u on u.user_name = t1.create_by and u.status = '0' inner join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id and d.status = '0'
where t1.del_flag = '0' and t2.dept_id = #{deptId} and t6.material_id in
#{item}
and t6.batch_number like concat('%', #{materialCode}, '%')
${params.dataScope} group by t2.dept_id,t2.dept_name,t6.material_id ) ) t group by dept_id,dept_name,material_id

SELECT t1.material_id,t4.`code` as material_code,t4.`name` as material_name,t5.`name` as unit_name, t3.id as plan_id,t3.plan_name,sum(t2.predict_count) as predict_count,sum(t1.actual_count) as actual_count,sum(t1.check_difference_count) as check_difference_count FROM t_check_result t1 LEFT JOIN t_task_detail t2 on t1.task_detail_id = t2.id LEFT JOIN t_check_delivery t3 on t3.id = t2.plan_id LEFT JOIN t_material t4 on t4.id = t1.material_id LEFT JOIN t_unit t5 on t5.id = t4.unit_id WHERE t1.del_flag=0 and t2.del_flag=0 and t4.`code` like concat('%',#{materialCode},'%') and t4.`name` like concat('%',#{materialName},'%') and t3.plan_name like concat('%',#{planName},'%') GROUP BY t1.material_id,t4.`code`,t4.`name`,t5.`name`,t3.plan_name,t3.id ORDER BY t3.id DESC
mapper.delete: update t_check_result set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}

update t_check_result set del_flag = '1' where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT t3.`code` as tray_code,t4.`name` as location_name,t2.predict_count,t1.actual_count,t1.check_difference_count,t1.task_detail_id,t2.status FROM t_check_result t1 LEFT JOIN t_task_detail t2 on t1.task_detail_id = t2.id LEFT JOIN t_tray t3 on t3.id = t2.tray_id LEFT JOIN t_location t4 on t4.id = t2.location_id where t1.del_flag=0 and t2.del_flag=0 and t1.material_id=#{materialId} and t2.plan_id=#{planId}
